Quicksort Partition and Recursion Analysis

Algorithms & Divide and Conquer

1. Algorithm Overview

Quicksort is an efficient divide-and-conquer sorting algorithm. It selects an element as a pivot and partitions the given array around the picked pivot. For the initial input array [38, 27, 43, 3, 9, 82, 10], Lomuto partition chooses 10 as the pivot, moving elements smaller than 10 to the left [3, 9] and greater elements to the right [27, 43, 82, 38]. 

function quicksort(arr, low, high):
  if low < high:
    pivot_idx = partition(arr, low, high)
    quicksort(arr, low, pivot_idx - 1)
    quicksort(arr, pivot_idx + 1, high)

At each step, comparison indices i and j advance, swapping out-of-order elements until the pivot reaches its final sorted position.
